name: tract_developer_aggregation_r9
description: Where R9 falls in a pass, by hand from 4.3, 4.9.2, 4.15.3 and the R9 row of 4.22; R2 values from the Python cRZRandom model (default seed 0x4C09C113); R9 from the zones.md seeded test (zone developer generator lcg 0x8C09C68A: U(4) = 3). Manufacturing developer (purpose 7, wealth 2, zone code 8, target zone 3), demand 10; four empty 1 x 1 lots facing 0 at (0, 0), (1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 1) (tokens 1-4); one square 2 x 2 configuration 101 (family 800 = {0x500}, capacity 10). Aggregation: lot 1's trial (b) (anchor (1, 0), rect 0..1 x 0..1) and lot 2's trial (a) (same rect) are legal; every other trial leaves the city or has a cell without a lot. Industrial scoring (no lot costs, zero network counts) draws one R2 per candidate: 0.5705060362815857, 0.12462610006332397 -> scores 11.41.., 2.49..: lot 2's candidate first. PickBuilding: R4 of 1, R5 of 1. Build claims 10; PerformAggregation demolishes and deletes lots 1-4 (lot set in token order), then, purpose 7 with a square configuration, calls CreateLotIfPossible with facing -1: the rectangle is free (code 8), so the lot manager's CreateLotToFaceRoad draws U(4) = 3 on the zone developer's generator (R9, recorded by the harness host in the shared trace) before the lot is made (the harness has no roads, so the lot faces 3); RedisplayTerrain; StartConstruction. Per-pass order: R1, R2 x 2, R4, R5, R9. Purpose 7 stops after the success: outcomes [27], built 10. A second aggregation through the same generator draws its next value (0).
